key_facts: Willow (105 qubits) announced December 2024: below-threshold error correction, RCS benchmark in 5 min vs 10^25 years classically
Successor target: 500-1000 physical qubits by late 2026/early 2027
Milestone 3: long-lived logical qubit — stable state for days vs microseconds
Ultimate 2029 target: 1 million qubit machine for chemistry and materials science
No new processor announcement in March 2026 — roadmap unchanged from Dec 2024 disclosure
mera_relevance: Google's successor system at 500-1000 qubits would be capable of running large MERA circuits if gate fidelity reaches the Willow threshold level. However, superconducting systems still require SWAP routing for non-adjacent qubits, making them less efficient for MERA than trapped ion systems. This is a long-horizon watch item.
